business.description: Avonmore Capital & Management Services Limited is a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) registered with the Reserve Bank of India. The group, through its subsidiaries, operates in financial services (advisory, broking, wealth management, lending), infrastructure consultancy, and alcoholic beverage manufacturing (grain-based distillery and bottling).

outlook.statement: The Company is interested to set up a Greenfield project for manufacturing and supply of Fuel Ethanol in the state of Odisha up to 250 KL per day to be able to increase Ethanol supply and contribute to achieve the national targets of 10% blending.

Almondz Global Infra-Consultant Limited has been consistently taking initiatives to improve functional efficiency and remain in sync with the increase in growth of business. Implementation of ERP system and making collaboration with renowned international firms as knowledge partners are some of the recent strategic moves initiated by the company.

Infrastructure Advisory Business to remain primary growth driver, supported by highest ever order book and continuing government infrastructure spend, with management guiding towards 18-20% growth in this segment.
Green Fuel Business expected to move towards fuller utilisation as commercial production ramps up and OMC procurement arrangements are finalised.
Financial Services segment has already shown signs of recovery in Q1 FY27, with mark-to-market losses from previous quarter substantially reversing amid improved market sentiment.
Planned amalgamation of four wholly-owned subsidiaries expected to simplify corporate structure and improve operating efficiency over time.

Overall outlook remains constructive but performance sensitive to capital-market conditions, execution timelines on infrastructure and green-fuel projects, and broader macroeconomic and geopolitical environment including developments in West Asia and impact on energy prices.
